# PAIR — Pairing

- Owner: `ticonnect-net`
- Stage: 5
- Layer: `services`
- Component graph: [generated/components/pair.md](generated/components/pair.md)

## Purpose

Authenticate a first-time peer with SPAKE2 over PIN or QR, confirm the transcript, and commit trust.

## Boundary

Owns pairing state and endpoint. Unpaired peers can reach only this endpoint. Commits trust through identity and storage.

## Owned state

- pairing session state
- one-time token

## Invariants

- `INV-DISC-1` — Discovery produces candidates only and never implies trust. Test: planned: crates/net/tests/discovery.rs
- `INV-LIMIT-1` — Every queue, buffer, and frame decoder is bounded or declares its drop policy. Test: planned: design review plus fuzz tests
- `INV-SEC-1` — No secret, key, message body, or keystroke is logged by default. Test: planned: logging redaction tests
- `INV-STAGE-1` — Every stage demo uses only components from that stage or earlier stages. Test: cargo xtask systems --check
- `INV-TLS-1` — Certificate pinning fails closed on unknown or mismatched fingerprints. Test: planned: crates/net/tests/tls.rs
- `INV-TRUST-1` — No non-pairing feature is reachable before trust is established. Test: planned: crates/net/tests/unpaired_rejected.rs

## Failure semantics

- bounded attempts
- single-use token
- constant-time confirmation
- fail closed
